title: Reductions Of Crystalline Representations Of Fractional Slope $<p-1$
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $V_{k,a_p}$ be the two-dimensional crystalline representation of the Galois group of ${\mathbb Q}_p$ of weight $k \geq 2$ and parameter $a_p \in \bar{\mathbb{Q}}_p$. We study the semi-simplification $\bar{V}_{k,a_p}$ of the mod $p$ reduction of $V_{k,a_p}$ when the slope (valuation of $a_p$) is a positive fraction $< p-1$ using the mod $p$ local Langlands correspondence.
